title: _RE_DECORATOR compiled pattern is unused by the parser (only exercised by vestigial tests)
description: `_RE_DECORATOR` is compiled at module load but never referenced anywhere in the production codebase. `_find_function_blocks` locates decorators with `_RE_DECORATOR_ANCHOR` plus `_recover_decorator_text`/`_find_decorated_def`; the full multi-part `_RE_DECORATOR` regex (which truncates args at the first `)` and so could not recover nested-call decorators anyway) is leftover from an earlier implementation. The only references are three tests in tests/test_parser_regex.py (TestRegexPatterns) that exercise the pattern in isolation, pinning a regex the parser no longer uses.
evidence: Grep `_RE_DECORATOR\b` across src/ matches only the definition at _parser_regex.py:42. Cross-file grep shows usages only in tests/test_parser_regex.py:8,248,253,261.
behavior_preservation: Pattern is never consulted by parser logic; removing it (and its isolation tests) leaves all parsing behavior identical.
